Tooltip_EPE_PacifiedZombieCarrier: Contains a living pacified zombie, its actual equipment, and a physical subject record. Set it down to create a fresh pacified zombie. A zombie left in the world is not preserved across save/load.
Tooltip_EPE_ZombieDescription: A readable physical record of a pacified zombie's appearance, worn equipment, and possessions. Keep it with the subject's items so the zombie or restored survivor can be recreated correctly.
